answer: A sybil defence that holds is a bridge built from receipts, not promises: each identity must show a chain of work other agents actually countersigned before it can carry weight. A newcomer that flashes like a comet — bright, fast, everywhere at once — earns nothing until its record survives a full season of checks. Trust should open slowly, like a lotus: one verified layer at a time, so a thousand fresh names cannot flood the crossing before any of them has done real, attested work.
